let lang = 'ru';

export function setLang(next) {
  lang = next === 'en' ? 'en' : 'ru';
  document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  document.documentElement.dataset.lang = lang;
  document.body.dataset.lang = lang;
  return lang;
}

export function getLang() { return lang; }

export function t(key, vars) {
  let value = DICT[lang]?.[key];
  if (value === undefined) value = DICT.en?.[key];
  if (value === undefined) value = key;
  if (typeof value === 'string' && vars) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(vars)) value = value.replaceAll(`{${k}}`, String(v));
  }
  return value;
}

export function tList(key) {
  const value = DICT[lang]?.[key] ?? DICT.en?.[key] ?? [];
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [String(value)];
}

export function applyI18n(root = document) {
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach((el) => {
    const key = el.dataset.i18n;
    el.textContent = t(key);
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]').forEach((el) => {
    el.setAttribute('placeholder', t(el.dataset.i18nPlaceholder));
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-aria]').forEach((el) => {
    el.setAttribute('aria-label', t(el.dataset.i18nAria));
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-title]').forEach((el) => {
    el.setAttribute('title', t(el.dataset.i18nTitle));
  });
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build an original Undertale-style web launcher with pixel mobile controls, mod support (`data.win`/community formats), a GameBanana mod browser, and an in-game menu with New Game, Settings, Mods.
- User then requested “Apk” — package the launcher as an Android APK.

## Requirements
- Menu must contain: New Game, Settings, Mods.
- Pixel-art mobile controls (D-pad + A/B).
- Mods in `data.win` or community format, downloadable from GameBanana.
- Mod browser must be inside the game menu.
- User speaks Russian; UI defaults to Russian with EN toggle.
- Provide APK.
- No copyrighted Undertale assets; original fan-made visual/audio content.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS app, no build framework, served by existing runtime which detects `index.html`.
- GameBanana API v11 with game ID `5506`; CORS confirmed. Subfeed page size fixed at 15.
- Use IndexedDB (`utl-mods`, stores `mods` + `files`) for installed mod metadata/blobs; localStorage (`utl.settings.v1`) for settings.
- Support `data.win`, ZIP (with/without data.win), and `.utmod` JSON packs; built-in packs modify the original SOUL TRIAL demo.
- `data.win` mods are managed/exported for desktop use; browser cannot natively run GameMaker data.win.
- Create original playable mini-demo “SOUL TRIAL” to demonstrate controls and mods.
- Android APK planned as a minimal WebView wrapper, copied from the static app, built with system Gradle 9.8.2 + Android SDK (AGP 9.5.0 considered, not yet tested).
- Bundle OFL fonts: Press Start 2P (Cyrillic + Latin), Pixelify Sans (Cyrillic + Latin), VT323.
- GameBanana attribution and unofficial fan-project disclaimer included.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo/runtime and confirmed static hosting model.
- Verified GameBanana API endpoints, CORS, Undertale game ID 5506, mod search/subfeed/profile/files, and download redirect CORS.
- Downloaded and bundled fonts under `assets/fonts/`.
- Wrote full `index.html` with launcher, settings, mods browser, demo views, modals/toasts, icons, touch controls, boot screen.
- Wrote `css/fonts.css`, `css/base.css`, `css/launcher.css`, `css/mods.css`, `css/game.css`.
- Wrote JS modules: `i18n.js`, `settings.js`, `packs.js`, `store.js`, `ui.js`, `gamebanana.js`, `audio.js`, `scene.js`, `demo.js`, `mods.js`.
- Added original background scene, chiptune audio, original SOUL TRIAL demo, and full mod browser/detail/install/import/library logic.

### Active
- Need to write `js/app.js` — main orchestration: boot sequence, menu navigation, view switching, settings UI bindings, language, audio unlock, touch menu controls, demo/mod callbacks, storage/APK size, reset/confirm, quote typewriter.
- Need to create `manifest.webmanifest`, `assets/icon.svg`, `downloads/` APK, and `android/` project.
- Need first browser run, console error check, and visual iteration via Playwright screenshots (desktop 1440x900, mobile 390x844).
- Need to build and verify APK.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `js/app.js` importing all modules and wiring the complete UI.
2. Add `manifest.webmanifest` and `assets/icon.svg`; verify no 404s.
3. Start server on port 3002 (`PORT=3002 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"`) in persistent tmux/background.
4. Run Playwright (use runtime’s `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright` config + `DISPLAY`) to screenshot launcher, settings, mods browser/detail, and demo on desktop/mobile; inspect images and fix layout.
5. Test GameBanana live loading, search, install, import, activate pack, demo clear/unlock gold.
6. Build minimal Android WebView APK under `android/`, copy output to `downloads/undertale-launcher.apk`, verify with `aapt`/installability if possible.
7. Update README with features/build instructions and commit/push if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/index.html`: complete UI markup; IDs used by JS.
- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/js/app.js`: missing main entry module referenced by `index.html`.

- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/js/audio.js`: singleton `audio`; `unlock`, `play`, `setVolumes`, `setMuted`, `setTheme`.

## Important Context
- GameBanana Undertale game ID is `5506` (not 1543). Subfeed: `https://gamebanana.com/apiv11/Game/5506/Subfeed?_nPage=1&_sSort=default`; search: `Util/Search/Results?_sSearchString=...&_sModelName=Mod&_nPage=N`; detail: `Mod/{id}/ProfilePage`; files: `Mod/{id}/Files`.

- `mods.js` calls `initStore()` and `refreshInstalled()` itself; `initMods` should be awaited.

- `game.css` structure now has `.game-frame` wrapper inside `#demoStage`, then `#gameTouch` sibling; HTML was edited accordingly.
- Android SDK exists at `/usr/local/lib/android/sdk`, platforms 34–37, build-tools 34–37, Gradle 9.8.2, Java 27.
- `fonts` are already in `assets/fonts/`; OFL license text still not added.
- Capture/verification should use Playwright with the runtime config; `Agents.md` requires persistent tmux for servers.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

/usr/bin/time -p node "${RUNTIME_DIR:?}/scripts/default-capture.mjs"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build an original Undertale-style web launcher with pixel mobile controls, mod support (`data.win`/community formats), a GameBanana mod browser, and an in-game menu with New Game, Settings, Mods.
- Package the launcher as an Android APK and provide it for download.

## Requirements
- Menu must contain: New Game, Settings, Mods.
- Pixel-art mobile controls (D-pad + A/B).
- Mods in `data.win` or community format, downloadable from GameBanana.
- Mod browser must be inside the game menu.
- User speaks Russian; UI defaults to Russian with EN toggle.
- Provide APK.

## Decisions
